about: Registry of the microservices of one Fractera server. The SAME file in every service tree, byte for byte. English only. Filled by hand for now. A service READS it and never writes it: a file that each service edits stops being the same file.
root_note: The single microservice mounted at the domain root: it answers both at <domain> and at its own subdomain. Exactly one service may hold it; moving it is a one-word change here.

auth_kinds.global: signs people in through the platform auth service — one door for the whole server
auth_kinds.own: checks its own credential and knows nothing about people; reached by processes, not by browsers
auth_kinds.provider: IS the auth service: it hands authorisation to the others. Exactly one service may say this — two authorities on one server is no authority at all

channel_kinds.telegram: a Telegram bot of this service: { bot: "@name", url: "https://t.me/name" }. Both fields are required — a channel without a link sends a person nowhere, and that looks like a broken messenger.

channels_note: OPTIONAL per service. A service answering a request that is not its own sends the address in the SAME channel the request arrived by, and falls back to `manage` (the web address) when it has no such channel. The link is stored whole and never assembled from the bot name.

services.about: Guest application on port 3000. The site a visitor sees. Ships to the user's own repository.
services.author: fractera

services.about: Sign-in service on port 3001. One entry point for every service of this server; issues the session others read.
services.author: fractera

services.about: Control panel on port 3002. Deployment, domains, configs, products. Lives outside the user's repository.
services.author: fractera

services.about: Data layer on port 3300. The single door to stored data and the one route other services use to reach each other: /service/<id>/*.
services.author: fractera

services.about: Geo service on port 3400. Routing and geocoding over OSRM and Nominatim.
services.author: fractera

services.about: Channels service on port 3500. Holds bot credentials and schedules; the only holder of the Telegram token.
services.author: fractera

services.about: Knowledge graph on port 9621, LightRAG. Entities, relations and graph answers.
services.author: fractera

services.about: Telegram service on port 3600. Automations, fact intake and the agent channel. Independent product: works with no guest application present.
services.author: fractera

services.about: Memory on port 3700. Black box with three verbs: remember, recall, feedback. Keeps what was said and gives it back.
services.author: fractera

services.about: AI browser on port 3800, Camoufox engine. Opens a real page for services and agents, one page at a time.
services.author: fractera

manage_note: Where this service is configured by a person, and the words that mean a request belongs to it. A service with no page of its own has manage: null — said, not implied.
